text:
Nina (PM): Quick thread: several customers confused by the single-line 'Retention: 30d' in Project Settings. They ask: is this policy or effective retention?
Omar (Design): We should split it: 'Policy: 30 days' and 'Effective: 18 days (route: analytics-ingest)'. Also add a 'What's this?' help link.
Priya (Security): Also calling the KMS banner 'BYOK' only is terse. Suggest: 'Customer-managed key (BYOK)' on first view, then abbreviate. And key state must be explicit: Active / Disabled / Rotated.
Luca (Frontend): Implementation plan: add i18n keys settings.kms.label.full and settings.retention.summary. Use aria-describedby to link the help tooltip. Will add data-event-code attributes to audit DOM nodes for SIEMs.
Omar (Design): Microcopy variants to test:
A) "Policy: 30 days · Effective: 18 days"
B) "Policy 30d — Effective 18d (overridden)"
And the key pill: "Customer-managed key (BYOK) — Active" with a lock icon.
Priya (Security): Audit log guidance: use machine codes plus human text, e.g., event_code=kms.rotate, message="KMS key rotated — user: bob@example.com (console)". Include key fingerprint.
Nina (PM): Action items: Omar mock two compact variants, Luca will add aria and data hooks behind a flag, Priya will add audit schema snippet to docs. I'll coordinate with support.
ci-bot: Scheduled deploy: microcopy PR #490 to staging at 1955550015.
Luca (Frontend): I'll open the PR after tests. ETA EOD.
